propositions: Code-review findings raised on one patchset but not re-emitted on the next reach no consumer because the sidecar payload is keyed by (change_id, revision) and one artifact is emitted per revision.

A new carry-forward mechanism must classify prior findings by region state (still-present, addressed, withdrawn) and inject eligible surfaced-only items with empty evidence into fresh Pass-1 output at the merge step.

Carried findings must respect posture clamp: standing.origin_decision from the prior surfaced bucket (blocking->block, advisory->advisory, default advisory) prevents reinvention of blocking posture across patchsets.
Per-finding state classification lives in llm/code_review/carry_forward.py reading prior payload deps via extended latest_code_review_result, not in merge_findings which sees only finding lists.
Carry-forward is one-shot: an already-carried item (withdrawn state) cannot be carried again, so the chain terminates after a single patchset even if the cited region continues to change.
